Resort-Style Luxury or Secluded Country Privacy: Two Build-Ready Acreage Tracts Just Hit the Market

ByChloe Kopal
  • PublishedAugust 4, 2026
FacebookMastodonEmailShare


Listen to audio version of this article

Instaread
Looking to build? Here are two new, very different tracts that just hit the market. One is a 2.5-acre lot with Sulphur Springs Country Club access and the other is a 15-plus wooded spot east of Mount Pleasant.
 
 
1. High Point Estates a country subdivision with access to the County Club–Build your dream home on this beautiful 2.52-acre corner lot in the highly sought-after High Point Estates country estate subdivision.
 
Perched at a high elevation, this partially cleared and buildable homesite offers breathtaking 360-degree views of the surrounding countryside, creating the perfect backdrop for stunning sunrises and sunsets on your private estate property.
 
This premium acreage lot is already equipped with water, electricity, and fiber internet, providing convenience and readiness for your custom build. The property combines natural beauty with modern infrastructure, making it an ideal setting for luxury country living.
 
Residents of High Point Estates also enjoy access to the Sulphur Springs Country Club and a private community fishing pond with a pier, offering excellent recreational opportunities. With its prime location, scenic views, and exceptional amenities, this property is the perfect place to bring your dream country estate to life.
 
The current asking price $125,000 for 2.52 acres. Call or text Janet Martin for more info, 903-243-0184.
 

1-3

Image 1 of 22

 
2. Mostly wooded 15.69 Acres with utilities Northeast of Mount Pleasant–Diverse acreage with established home site waiting for new owners to make it their own! This property features a healthy mix of woods, pasture, and everything in between. There is an old storehouse and shed that are both well over 100 years old. Current house is in poor condition and is of little value.
 
Located on County Road 4025 in Mount Pleasant, the current asking price is $225,000. Call or text Jed Walker for more info, 903-335-4175.
